name: Vostok-2
about: Vostok-2 (1961 TAU 1), a crewed vehicle (Vostok3A), launched 1961 Aug  6. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1961 Aug  6), held fixed
